scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend "pnpm --filter blogs dev" "pnpm --filter bloglist-frontend dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter bloglist-frontend build && rm -rf blogs/dist && cp -R bloglist-frontend/dist blogs/dist
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter blogs lint && pnpm --filter bloglist-frontend lint
scripts.test: pnpm --filter blogs test && pnpm --filter bloglist-frontend vitest
